integrity: The stationary measure and finite-volume double-sum are credited to their originators. Analytical asymptotics and all limitations are stated; no independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proof relies on the published exact finite-volume stationary flux; interior densities only; first infinite volume at fixed positive noise, then zero-noise asymptotics. Finite arithmetic checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof. Relevant earlier automaton formulas can reduce novelty.
title: Exact two-density thermodynamic current and square-root noise smoothing in a five-neighbor particle automaton
